name: Sony DualShock 3 behind DsHidMini (SXS mode)
connections: SDL reads it from feature report 0, as with Sony's driver; OpenController reads the same report for the motion SDL leaves out (ds3.rs).
sources: SDL 3.4 src/joystick/hidapi/SDL_hidapi_ps3.c (feature report 0, motion words from byte 41 of the data)
DsHidMini 3 and Sony's driver: 113 counts a g around 512, little-endian, X mirrored, the gyro flipped
DS4Windows and PadForge's SDL fork, checked on real controllers: 123 counts per 90 degrees a second
An OpenController report's words at rest, as the demo shows them
